text: J and K Bank has a moat most banks would envy. Forty two percent of its deposits are cheap current and savings money.
Clue one. A year ago, it was forty six.
Clue two. New deposits this year, twenty four thousand eight hundred crore. Cheap CASA brought just four and a half thousand.
The twist. The other eighty two percent came from costlier term deposits. Loans grew twenty four percent, so the bank needed the money.
The moat is still wide, but it's getting thinner. Back to the napkin.
